title: 彭博分析师Catherine Lim：中国AI竞赛双轨并行，阿里获监管信任成关键
speaker: Catherine Lim

segments.en: Okay. So this is another hardware play then. You have Huawei, ZTE. How does this reshape the AI race in China?
segments.zh: 所以这是另一个硬件布局？有华为、中兴。这如何重塑中国的AI竞赛？

segments.en: Yeah. China's AI race can be broken up into two tracks. One is hardware-centric ecosystems from Huawei to Xiaomi, and cloud-based AI services from Baidu.
segments.zh: 中国AI竞赛可分为两条轨道：一是从华为到小米的硬件生态，二是百度的云端AI服务。

segments.en: They will continue to embed their own models into devices and apps. The other track is where Alibaba comes in, because it is an infrastructure provider that foreign platforms can depend on.
segments.zh: 它们会继续将自有模型嵌入设备和应用。另一条轨道是阿里巴巴，因为它是一个外国平台可以依赖的基础设施提供商。

segments.en: The Apple deal itself doesn't mean it's going to knock off Huawei or Xiaomi. They will continue to lead on integrated device plus AI, if you ask me.
segments.zh: 苹果交易本身并不意味着它会击败华为或小米。在我看来，它们仍将在设备+AI集成方面领先。

segments.en: Really what we now should focus on is that in China itself, the regulatory trust, the governance, it's going to be as critical as the raw model platform itself. With this sign-off from the authorities, Alibaba can now formally be recognized as a partner that can keep global AI within China.
segments.zh: 我们现在真正应该关注的是，在中国，监管信任和治理将与模型平台本身一样关键。有了监管批准，阿里巴巴现在可以被正式视为一个能将全球AI留在中国的合作伙伴。

segments.en: And again, with this sign-off from the authorities, I think Alibaba can now formally be recognized as a partner that can keep global AI within China.
segments.zh: 再次强调，有了监管批准，我认为阿里巴巴现在可以被正式视为一个能将全球AI留在中国的合作伙伴。
